column1: # best-config.tsv — EMPIRICALLY-BEST per-query forst-rs config for the 8 NexMark priority queries.
# PURPOSE: best-PERFORMANCE reproduction. Per-query config is INTENTIONAL here
# (the user reversed the same-config constraint 2026-06-14). This is DISTINCT
# from the uniform-config research question driven by run-remote-nexmark-v3.sh,
# which deliberately holds ONE config for all queries. Use run-best.sh to apply.
#   - "V3 FULL 8-QUERY" (flag-ON: lz4 + KV-sep + trivial-move + S2-pinned)  tip 1cda0e724
#   These two are a SAME-PASS A/B (serial, same tip-family) => the flag-ON-vs-OFF
#   per-query deltas are REAL, not box noise. See the doc's
#   - q17 best wall 83.7s is from the routing-adaptive (R2a) capture
# KNOB NAMES verified against engine code (crates/forst-rs-engine/src/db.rs):
#   FRS_S2_FANOUT_MIN    usize, default usize::MAX=OFF (R1 adaptive) db.rs:15601
#   FRS_SST_COMPRESSION  none|lz4|zstd, engine default lz4          db.rs:299
#   query  KV_SEPARATION  KV_MIN_BLOB_SIZE  TRIVIAL_MOVE  S2_PINNED  S2_FANOUT_MIN  RS_EXECUTOR  SST_COMPRESSION  expected_wall_s  status  note
#   - status: MEASURED       = the encoded config produced expected_wall_s in a captured run.
#             NEEDS-CONFIRM   = best-known config but THIS exact knob combination's wall is
#                               UNMEASURED (the encoded value is the best component-measured
#                               estimate; a confirming run is required before trusting it).

column11: KV-sep ON wins (flag-ON 311 vs flag-OFF 384, +23%). Retract-changelog cadence rows ~25.8M (documented, not a defect). Beats RDB 1.09x; ForSt DNF(OOM).
KV-sep ON wins big (flag-ON 695 vs flag-OFF 937, +35%). Heaviest windowed-join; -26% vs prior V10. PASS RDB 1.16x; loses to ForSt.
KV-sep MUST be OFF on the 35g Mac: flag-ON DNF (TM OOM ~75-83M, reproducible x2); flag-OFF FINISHES 1828.7s (RSS ~2GiB lower). Beats ForSt 2002.5 by completing.

KV-sep OFF wins (flag-OFF 118.8 vs flag-ON 215.8, -45%). Flips both-FAIL->both-PASS (1.12x RDB). Windowed-MapState-agg drain. NOTE: R2a (routing-adaptive) ALSO helped q11 historically (318.9->135.7); the OFF+R2a combo is UNMEASURED -- current cell encodes the best MEASURED (plain OFF, 118.8). See run-best.sh q11-r2a variant.
Source-bound parity; KV-sep neutral (flag-ON 40.6 ~ flag-OFF 41.6). Either works; left at engine default (OFF).

BEST wall 83.7 = KV-sep-OFF regime + R2a routing-adaptive (/tmp/v3-q17 capture). Plain KV-sep-OFF inline measured 110.7 (flag-OFF pass); KV-sep-ON measured 150.7 (flag-ON). The OFF+routing-adaptive 83.7 is from a SEPARATE capture, NOT the clean serial flag-OFF pass -> CONFIRM the OFF+routing-adaptive wall on a quiet box. Fallback MEASURED config = OFF/inline @110.7.
#1 KV-sep-ON beneficiary (flag-ON 216 vs flag-OFF 464, +115% = largest swing). BEATS BOTH backends (0.82x RDB, 1.18x ForSt). Value-carrying interval-join + Top-N read path.

KV-sep ON wins (flag-ON 824.4 vs flag-OFF 956.3, +16%). NEAR RDB 1.26x (busy-disk noise; quiet box likely PASS <=1.25x). PASS ForSt 1.63x. R1 adaptive-S2 (FRS_S2_FANOUT_MIN) is a candidate further lever for this deep-probe join (UNMEASURED here).
